{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sauces|Sauces]]

'''Cheese sauce''' is a variation of [[Cookbook:Béchamel Sauce|Béchamel Sauce]].

== Ingredients ==
* 2½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1½ tablespoons [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy whipping cream]] or ½ cup whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]], hot
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* ⅓ cup grated [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] (optional)
* 1½–2 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinches]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
# Melt the butter in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Add the flour and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together over medium heat for 2–3 minutes, to make a white [[Cookbook:Roux|roux]]. Do not allow to brown. Remove from heat and allow to cool nearly to room temperature.
# Gradually add hot heavy whipping cream to the roux, whisking to combine. This will also work with a hot roux and room temperature heavy cream or milk.
# Add the salt, cheese, and mustard, then heat till just [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmering]] and cheese has melted.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* If desired, you may bring the sauce to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]; once the cheese sauce has come to a boil, lower the heat to low and very slowly simmer for about 45 minutes. Stir it every so often to avoid sticking to the bottom (a whisk is appropriate here). 
* Do not allow the sauce to brown. 
* The longer the sauce is simmered, the smoother it becomes due to the cooking and swelling of the starch grains.
